item.title: LongTake 1.7
item.description:
LongTake v1.7 (Build 206)

  • Session-isolated recording state machine & callback draining before AVAssetWriter finalization
  • Unified monotonic pause/resume timeline across video, system audio, and microphone
  • Zero-copy buffer use-after-free fix, 64-bit >24h offline mixing, collision-free file allocation, and full Quit protection
  • Sparkle 2.10.1 self-hosted EdDSA OTA channel for HazelKahlil/LongTake with active-recording relaunch guard
